text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While searching high and low for Sirius Symboli, who hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, Senpai...
Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Get lost already, you're annoying.
Don't you ever show your pathetic face around here again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems like there's some kind of story behind this.
As I was wondering how to approach her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Eavesdropping, huh? What a poorly mannered dog.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However—for today, perhaps I should reflect on myself.
In fact, there have been delays in training.
choice_data_list: Still, you must have had a reason, right?
Still, you had a reason, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The reason doesn't matter.
I bear the responsibility for slacking off.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting her straightforward apology,
I decided not to pursue the matter any further.
